body: Is this bug fixed? Still happening in @storybook 6.5.9
@GabrielAPineiro I've updated the example to 6.5.9 and can confirm the same issues exist.

Great analysis @Marklb and sorry for the delayed response. You are absolutely right and the answer is pretty simple:

> Does the StoryStore have a place for frameworks to hook into that step, like they used to with the start function, or an alternative way they should be doing this? 

Yes, they should export an annotation `applyDecorators` from their preview "config" file. This is a simple bug (🤦 ) -- it is exported as the wrong thing:

https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/bc436e15f1cd53207c5ffd7b93828de715c8a92f/code/frameworks/angular/src/client/config.ts#L4

Compare to the vue renderer:

https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/bc436e15f1cd53207c5ffd7b93828de715c8a92f/code/renderers/vue/src/config.ts#L7
Would you like to submit a PR fixing it?

issue.title: Angular: StoryStoreV7 breaks components with decorators

labels.name: needs reproduction
labels.description: Indicates that a reproduction repository must be provided for this issue

repository.name: storybook
repository.description: Storybook is the industry standard workshop for building, documenting, and testing UI components in isolation

issue.body:
**Describe the bug** After enabling the storyStoreV7 feature, stories that use decorators break, leaving an undefined message replacing the component. **To Reproduce** - Enable storyStoreV7 - Add a decorator to a story, example: `decorators: [componentWrapperDecorator((story) =>
${story}
)]` - Make sure the story does NOT have any template, so it uses the component. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28511609/176432803-34803d5a-b64a-412e-8e56-e94de0bc05bd.png) **Additional context** The story parameter of the decorator becomes undefined when turning storyStoreV7 on, so you are left with an undefined message. ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/28511609/176433450-3b5d3a0d-3c97-4df0-9243-53db1f731044.png)

body: This issue appears to have been fixed in https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/releases/tag/v6.5.13 and https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/releases/tag/v7.0.0-alpha.34
